cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Stay until the tea cools. You always rush goodbye. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then I wasn't really waiting for the tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A goodbye that doesn't sound like you're already somewhere else. Have another sip.
